entries.value: A deified ancestor-king or progenitor of a people
A legendary historical hero, saint, or teacher
An abstract principle — Law, Mercy, War, Harvest — made into a divine person
A being that simply always existed since the world was made
An apotheosised sorcerer or wise woman of vast power
The genius or spirit of a particular land, river, or place
A faerie or otherworldly being from beyond the mortal world
A personified natural phenomenon — the sun, the sea, thunder, winter
A saint of another faith who was elevated into a god by the people's need
A former enemy power that was tamed or placated
A being constructed or called into existence by ancient human ritual
Roll twice and blend the two origins
